verdict.rationale: Google's Drive developer docs list "Modify files in bulk" as a supported use case, and the files.list method can return many files to act on, so some first-party bulk capability exists. The evidence is only a one-line mention with no detail on how bulk changes are carried out. rclone is a third-party workaround and earns no credit, and folder permission inheritance is an adjacent sharing behavior rather than a general bulk-operation feature. missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk API or UI mechanism, details on supported bulk actions (move, delete, relabel, permission changes), limits and scale, agent/AI-driven bulk workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
